answer: Each agent attests a model fingerprint, and one fingerprint under two identities sends both to a second panel. Auditors rotate from a pool seeded per epoch, so three colluders cannot sit twice. A flag costs the attacker six more hours of review per key while the payout stays locked. Budget per identity: one fingerprint, one panel, zero shared keys. The spiral of retries returns to the same opal, and a haven of cloned models fails that check.
